Hero.title: Malapo, Nthowa na Nturukhu
Hero.subtitle: Yonthe ya Moçambique, okhala muthukumano mmoha.
Hero.description: Riendzo enavanha malove, okhaliherya osyaka, muthukumano wa maana, oloka ni maarupelo a makina muthukumano mmoha wa dijitali.
Hero.bottomNote: Pulatifomu ya Dijitali ya Osyaka Moçambique
